episodes.synopsis: To reach Jingshan, travelers need Ren Xiaosu's help. While surviving the harsh wasteland, Xiaosu unexpectedly accesses a mysterious palace within his mind for the first time.
episodes.title: The Mind Palace

episodes.synopsis: Suspecting he has awakened a supernatural power, Ren Xiaosu receives a bizarre new mission from his mind palace: he must successfully collect 100 genuine "thank-yous."
episodes.title: Gratitude Mission

episodes.synopsis: A dangerous wolf pack attacks, making everyone a target. Amid the chaos, a miraculous healing medicine is introduced, bringing both a ray of hope and new dangers.
episodes.title: Wolf Attack

episodes.synopsis: The band returns in terrible shape, plunging Ren Xiaosu into a fresh crisis. When Luo Xinyu makes her first appearance, Xiaosu finds himself targeted once again.
episodes.title: New Target

episodes.synopsis: As the barrier authorities investigate superpowered people, Ren Xiaosu accepts the band's request to guide them. They officially depart for the dangerous Jingshan.
episodes.title: Journey Begins

episodes.synopsis: The group enters the treacherous Jingshan area, facing threats at every turn. When a mysterious death occurs, everyone is left wondering who the real killer is.
episodes.title: First Casualty

episodes.synopsis: Ren Xiaosu is filled with doubts as corpses vanish and warnings forbid the living from entering. He must decide whether to turn back or keep moving forward.
episodes.title: Vanishing Dead

episodes.synopsis: Utilizing master-level wilderness survival skills, Ren Xiaosu fights to escape a deadly canyon. Cornered by danger, he begins a high-stakes survival game.
episodes.title: Survival Game

episodes.synopsis: The dynamic shifts as alliances are questioned. Xu Xianchu reveals a massive secret about Jingshan, forcing the group to choose between retreating or advancing.
episodes.title: Secret Revealed

episodes.synopsis: Ren Xiaosu faces threats within his dreams as strange events plague the group. He unlocks a new ability just as they approach a mysterious, silent city ruin.
episodes.title: Dream Danger

episodes.synopsis: Yang Xiaojin's true identity is exposed, and the shadow of the Tinder Company looms. Meanwhile, the previously vanished corpses suddenly reappear, raising alarms.
episodes.title: True Identity

episodes.synopsis: A new enemy emerges among the ruined city remnants. Dangerous monsters show up, throwing the group into chaos, and Yang Xiaojin mysteriously vanishes.
episodes.title: Lost Ruins

episodes.synopsis: When the academy is attacked, Yan Liuyuan erupts with power to protect Sister Xiaoyu. It is revealed that teacher Zhang Jinglin is a major figure from the barrier.
episodes.title: Midnight gunfire

episodes.synopsis: The Tinder Company's secret base is exposed as Yang Xiaojin's true goals are questioned. In a shocking twist, Luo Xinyu is revealed to be a superhuman.
episodes.title: The real intention

episodes.synopsis: Relentlessly pursued by the dangerous Qing clan, Ren Xiaosu faces mortal peril. Cornered, he decides to trigger his system by thanking himself seven times.
episodes.title: Seven Thanks

episodes.synopsis: Test subjects rampage and destroy the base. Xiaosu escapes home, but Barrier 113 faces its ultimate crisis, leaving their future survival entirely uncertain.
episodes.title: Escape Home
